name: knowledge
description: The knowledge vault's hooks and MCP server for Claude Code and the Claude desktop app. Each hook runs the knowledge binary's hook verb, and the server is `knowledge mcp` (find, graph, read, note); knowledge setup installs this plugin and sets knowledge_bin.

knowledge_bin.title: knowledge binary
knowledge_bin.description: Absolute path of the knowledge binary the hooks and the MCP server run. knowledge setup writes it.
